description: This file defines the 'Extension' model for the Catalog setting namespace in the OpenCart system. It contains methods to retrieve extension data from the database, such as listing all extensions, listing extensions by type, and retrieving extension details by code.

classes.name: Extension
classes.description: Model class handling operations related to extensions in the catalog setting namespace.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all extensions.

methods.name: getExtensionsByType
methods.description: Retrieves extensions filtered by a specific type.

methods.name: getExtensionByCode
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific extension identified by its type and code.
